notes:
A piano and guitar practice app for Android.

New in 0.59: Learn mode. Tap the mode button until it says Learn. The piece is cut into short sections; for each one, Listen plays it, then Your turn counts you in and the music keeps moving while you play, marking each note green (in time), amber (early or late) or red (missed). With Auto on it goes round listen, play, listen, play until the section holds, then moves on. Switch off L or R to practise one hand while the app plays the other. Hold the next-section arrow to join two sections. Slower speeds also now run at the speed they say.

Watch plays the piece; Wait (the old Practice) stops at each note until you play it.

To hear the app through your piano instead of the phone: Settings, Play notes through, The piano.

Sixty-six public-domain scores are included. You can import MusicXML (.musicxml, .xml, .mxl), MIDI (.mid) and PDF.

This is a test build and updates itself: check for updates under Settings.
